narrative: Adversa's VIPER-MCP sweep of roughly 40,000 repositories filed 67 CVEs, nine tracing specifically to broken OAuth flows, while a Censys scan counts 12,520 mostly-unauthenticated internet-accessible MCP services and a separate study finds about 40% of remote servers expose tools with no auth at all. That quantifies the broken-AI-integration-authorization breach class the thesis rests on as a measured, recurring failure mode.
remaining_gap: The landing is an identity provider - Okta, Entra ID or Google Workspace - formally carving out a distinct AI-extension OAuth scope category, which vulnerability research alone does not constitute.
